children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game where the trio must stay in their triangle shape while navigating an obstacle course.

seniors.seated_version: Three chairs arranged in a triangle; dancers perform arm movements and hand-clapping patterns to simulate the formation changes.
seniors.standing_version: Reduced tempo; focus on the walking transitions between shapes rather than fast swing footwork.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slowed to 50% of competition speed; small steps to maintain balance.

prerequisites.description: Basic knowledge of Swedish Bugg or Lindy Hop

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Used to maintain connection between three dancers simultaneously
movement_profile.footwork: Derived from Swedish Bugg and Lindy Hop
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dynamic shifting between lines, circles, and triangles
movement_profile.partnering: Trio-based lead and follow; one leader managing two followers

signature_moves.description: The trio shifts between geometric shapes like triangles and lines
signature_moves.name: Formation change

signature_moves.description: Dancers swap positions within the trio while maintaining the dance flow
signature_moves.name: Place changing

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Colliding with the second follower during turns; losing the geometric formation

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by modern pop production or classic rock'n'roll arrangements, featuring a clear, driving beat suitable for athletic swing dancing.

basic_steps: Establish a trio connection with a central leader and two followers
Execute basic Bugg footwork in a 4/4 rhythm
Rotate positions to form a triangle
Transition from a triangle into a linear formation
Perform a place-change where the leader moves between the two followers
teaching.formation: Trio (typically 1 leader, 2 followers) forming lines, circles, and triangles
teaching.level_notes: Requires prior knowledge of Swedish Bugg; focus on spatial awareness is critical for the trio.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time, typical of pop and rock'n'roll music
